mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fair_cancel_requests (fair_id, requested_by, reason, created_at) VALUES (#{fairId}, #{requestedBy}, #{reason}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT fair_cancel_request_id, fair_id, requested_by, reason, status, reject_reason, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, created_at FROM fair_cancel_requests WHERE fair_cancel_request_id = #{fairCancelRequestId}
SELECT fair_cancel_request_id, fair_id, requested_by, reason, status, reject_reason, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, created_at FROM fair_cancel_requests WHERE fair_id = #{fairId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT fair_cancel_request_id, fair_id, requested_by, reason, status, reject_reason, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, created_at FROM fair_cancel_requests WHERE fair_id = #{fairId} AND status = 'PENDING' LIMIT 1
mapper.update:
UPDATE fair_cancel_requests
status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt},
WHERE fair_cancel_request_id = #{fairCancelRequestId} AND status = 'PENDING'
